Name: Warp Totems to OoT Spells
Author: joiinks
Description:
[NOT UPDATED FOR 1.6]

This mod replaces the Warp Totems (as well as the Rain Totem if desired) with spells in crystal casings modeled after Ocarina of Time's spells like Din's Fire and Nayru's Love. All 6 will be enabled by default, but you can configure the Warp Totems and the Rain Totems separately.

In the future I would like to change the names from "totems" as well since it's a little culturally insensitive and just to make them appear as spells in game as well. (This seems like it won't be possible until 1.6 releases.)
